findings.detail: Whoever holds this mint's authorities can freeze or move it after it lands. That exposes the payee more than you, and it also means a refund of this payment is not entirely within their power.

warnings: 7dGbd2QZcCKcTndnHcTL8q7SMVXAkp688NTQYwrRCrar can freeze token accounts for mint EPjFWd…Dt1v, including the one you are paid into. A frozen balance is still yours and cannot be moved, for as long as they choose.
Mint EPjFWd…Dt1v can still issue more supply (mint authority BJE5MMbqXjVwjAF7oxwPYXnTXDyspzZyt4vwenNw5ruG). That dilutes the token without affecting your claim on what you hold.

note: This demand can be paid as stated, with 1 thing worth reading first.
